drafts.body:
The Miami Foundation reported that Give Miami Day had grown into the largest single-city giving day in the country.

Annelise, Early Giving opens for Give Miami Day on Saturday, November 14, 2026.

Event: Give Miami Day — Early Giving opens

The Miami Foundation team

drafts.body:

There's no ask in this note. We simply wanted you to know your support matters.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team
